name: Physics Sandbox
description: Bolt things together and find out. The pack has no win condition and no objective component, which is deliberate -- a sandbox that scores you is a puzzle game with extra steps. What it has instead is failure: movement.joint_builder's joints break under declared load, because a contraption that cannot fail has no engineering in it. presentation.force_visualizer is the pedagogy, not the debug output: a player who can see the torque on a joint learns why the arm bends, and the overlay reads without writing so switching it on can never change a result. Builds serialise to parts and joints, never to simulation state, so a shared contraption arrives standing up.
loop: spawn/join parts → apply forces → watch behavior → iterate

signatureCompound.name: It Floats Until It Doesn't
signatureCompound.description: Emergence with a failure mode: joint_builder bolts a hull to a powered hinge, fluid_buoyancy computes lift from the submerged fraction so the loaded end sits lower, force_visualizer draws the growing reaction at the joint, and the joint breaks at its declared load. contraption_save_load then hands the whole thing to someone else as parts and joints, so they can find the same limit.
